notes.title: Patch Notes for February Update
notes.content:
-Added full movement controls for Arrows
-Fixed bugs:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ -WASD doesn't unpause when in pause menu
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ -Mouse click doesn't do anything when it says "press any button to continue"
-Preparation for upcoming update involving more skins, more levels, and a secret surprise in shop
